'''2020 TMW Pods Chris Menzel LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Menzel]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Menzel]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
